summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K upon consummation of its acquisition of TopBuild Corp. via a merger agreement dated April 18, 2026. QXO acquired TopBuild through wholly owned subsidiaries Titanium MergerCo and Forward Merger Sub. No per-share price, premium, or deal value is stated in this excerpt. The filing also covers amendments to QXO's term loan facility to finance the acquisition. The board likely approved the transaction, though no recommendation or advisors are named. This is a definitive acquisition close. What to watch: integration risk and potential dilution if stock was used; no break fee or regulatory clock mentioned.
